evidence_quotes.agenda: No formal their-agenda question asked, though customer opened by saying he wanted 'an accurate description' of pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real, recurring concern (fear of hidden fees / surprise final bill) unprompted; rep addressed it twice with full explanations (no-hidden-fees framing, then the specific $800-bill worry) until he expressed satisfaction — scored as genuine two-layer follow-up, not the no-concern exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Explicitly said 'we will just move everything into the truck then that would really help keep the time down' (self-prep tip) and 'billed only every fifteen minutes' (pay-less-if-faster) — strongest Save-Your-Ass coverage of the batch, still missing rate/experience framing and a fair-check.

top_strength: Excellent handling of a highly engaged, fee-anxious customer — repeated reassurance until he was visibly relieved and booked on the spot.
coaching_note: Add the formal agenda question and the four differentiators (none of damage coverage / meet-your-mover / on-time / communication appeared) — the close itself was strong.
